title: random sts1 mods hehe
description:
Port of 11 Slay the Spire 1 mod characters to Slay the Spire 2:

The Packmaster
- Draft themed card packs at the start of each run (Core Set + 12 packs: Quiet, Biting Cold, Warlock, Even Odd, High Energy, Batter, Energy & Echo, Shaman, Warden, Farmer, Hermit, and Distortion), with relics and potions.

Downfall (10 characters)
- The Hermit
- The Awakened One
- The Gremlins
- The Champ
- The Snecko
- The Slime Boss
- The Guardian
- The Hexaghost
- The Automaton
- The Collector

Includes their full card pools, relics, potions, custom mechanics, animations, and visuals.

Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: Merge The Packmaster and Downfall into a single unified mod (RandomSts1Mods).
